title: Italian-Style Braised Pork Chops with Quick Curry Sauce
description: A fusion twist on traditional Italian braised pork chops, served with a flavorful and spicy quick curry sauce. Perfect for a cozy dinner with family and friends.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork chops until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork chops from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine (or beef broth) and bring to a boil.
Add the chicken broth, sugar (if using), and balsamic vinegar (if using).
Return the pork chops to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2-3 hours, or until the pork chops are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
